ns2:course.label: ECC Journal Topics
ns2:course.description: Review and discuss current veterinary literature pertaining to small animal emergency and critical care medicine. 1 graduate hour. No professional credit. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: DVM Degree. Restricted to Vet Med students.
